output.title: Initial Walk/Run Aerobic Introduction
output.description: Process: Brisk walk warm-up 5 min → 5 x (1 min jog @ Zone 2 easy feel / 1 min brisk walk recovery) → Walk cool-down 5 min. Overall: Welcome to day one of your running journey, starting with structured run/walk intervals designed to safely introduce impact to your connective tissues. Your longest unbroken jog target for this week is 1 minute, keeping the effort exceptionally controlled. Reason: Tendons, ligaments, and bone adapt at roughly one-seventh the rate of muscle, making gentle, interspersed run bouts essential to prevent micro-trauma. Benefit: Stimulates gentle bone remodeling, promotes initial collagen synthesis, and establishes baseline neuromuscular coordination for running. Warning: Stop immediately if you experience sharp localized pain around the shins, knees, or Achilles tendons, or if you feel dead legs lacking spring.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water only before or after the session as needed; no carbohydrates or electrolyte supplements are necessary for this 20-minute introductory effort.

output.title: Complete Rest & Tendon Recovery
output.description: Process: Rest and recover 0 min. Overall: A complete rest day to give your musculoskeletal system time to absorb yesterday's impact stimulus. Never run on consecutive days as a new runner. Reason: Connective tissues require a full 48-hour window between loading cycles to synthesize new collagen fibers safely. Benefit: Facilitates cellular repair, restores muscle glycogen stores, and prevents early onset overuse fatigue. Warning: If you wake up with joint stiffness or an elevated resting heart rate of 10-15 bpm above baseline, ensure you prioritize sleep and gentle hydration.
output.fueling_tip: Maintain regular balanced daily nutrition and adequate hydration; no sports nutrition products required.

output.title: Aerobic Foundation Walk/Run
output.description: Process: Brisk walk warm-up 5 min → 6 x (1 min jog @ Zone 2 easy feel / 1 min brisk walk recovery) → Walk cool-down 5 min. Overall: Your second running session repeats the 1-minute unbroken jog baseline with one additional interval rep. The walk intervals are a strictly prescribed part of your training to keep systemic fatigue low and form sharp. Reason: Repeating the proven 1-minute jog interval reinforces safe motor patterns while gradually expanding total on-feet time. Benefit: Increases mitochondrial density in slow-twitch muscle fibers and builds structural resilience across foot and ankle structures. Warning: Monitor for heavy dead legs or gait alterations; if your heart rate does not settle during the 1-minute walk breaks, walk the remaining duration without jogging.
output.fueling_tip: Sip plain water before heading out; exogenous carbohydrates are neither required nor recommended for this short session.

output.title: Foundational Durability Strength
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min mobility → Bodyweight Squats: 2x8, 90s rest → Glute Bridges: 2x10, 60s rest → Standing Calf Raises: 2x12, 60s rest → Bird Dogs: 2x8 each side, 60s rest → Cool down 5 min stretching. Overall: A foundational bodyweight strength routine focused entirely on hip stability, calf durability, and core control without any jumping or heavy weights. Every movement is performed deliberately with strict rest between sets. Reason: Building baseline stability in the glutes, hips, and calves protects your lower-leg tendons from the repetitive micro-impact of running. Benefit: Enhances pelvic control during single-leg stance and improves tendon stiffness to shield against shin splints. Warning: Avoid rushing through repetitions or bouncing at the bottom of squats; back off if you notice sharp joint twinges or knee discomfort.
output.fueling_tip: Drink plain water to stay hydrated; sports drinks or gels are unnecessary.

output.title: Weekend Aerobic Aerobic Progression
output.description: Process: Brisk walk warm-up 5 min → 7 x (1 min jog @ Zone 2 easy feel / 1 min brisk walk recovery) → Walk cool-down 5 min. Overall: The longest session of your first week, holding the unbroken jog metric steady at 1 minute while accumulating 7 gentle running minutes. You should be able to speak full, comfortable sentences throughout every jog segment. Reason: Caps your first week of running safely within your connective-tissue absorption limits while establishing routine. Benefit: Elevates baseline aerobic enzyme activity and capillary bed development around active muscle fibers. Warning: Watch for morning stiffness or lingering soreness from Friday; if you feel sluggish or receive a subjective C grade feel, walk the full duration.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water before and after the session is all that is required for this 24-minute session.
